_doc: Kaltenbrunn (map01) bosses, UPDATE 10 section 4 (docs/U10_CONTRACTS.md C5; docs/HOMAGE_BOSSES.md section 5; DECISIONS T-159, T-232 the boss rework). Loaded as GLData.table("bosses/map01"); one entry under "bosses" keyed by id. PAUL runs on HomageBoss (gravelight/enemies/homage/paul.gd) with PaulEncounter as his round director (paul_encounter.gd). hp_base is solo; HP = hp_base x (1 + hp_player_step x (players - 1)) x (1 + return_hp_step x visit). failsafe_seconds after he comes in he leaves (the designed retreat, which is the fail-safe) and returns return_after_min..max rounds later, stronger, until he is killed. bots_alone mirrors cousins.json (T-060). Likeness fields stay in likeness.json; no placeholder token is ever shown (HomageEncounter.fill_tokens / title_of). T-232 (docs/BOSS_REWORK.md 2.4): "dread" is the shared kit's block (BossFx: the presence meter, footfalls with boss_stomp and a view shake that grows per stage, flesh hits); "floods" the arena beat at BERSERK (the yard's lights die under his roar, the headframe's floods swing); "guard" the third-stage 'protect my guys' turn; "squad" the rules that read the squad's state; rage.flee_break the spike when a player runs out of his sight.

dread._doc: T-232: the kit's block. step_shake is the Calm value; Paul adds stage_step_shake per rage stage (Angry 0.65, BERSERK 0.85) and widens step_radius by stage_step_radius.

floods._doc: T-232: the arena beat at BERSERK. Every light within radius of him dims to level under his roar (BossFx.lights_dim), gutters for flicker_s, and gutters again every again_s while he stays BERSERK; the headframe's floods swing for swing_s (PaulEncounter.swing_lamps). The light comes back over restore_s when he shrinks out of BERSERK, leaves or dies.

guard._doc: T-232: 'protect my guys' (BERSERK only). A downed player within search m in his sight: he walks to the body, stands over it (arms spread) for up to max s and slams anyone who comes within approach m: a telegraph s wind-up (pose + paul_roar + the light), then damage + knockdown in a half-circle of radius m (arc_deg wide) in FRONT of him; he turns to face the comer only when a slam starts, so a teammate can revive from the far side. cooldown between slams; after a guard ends he does not guard again for again_after s. Not a grab: nothing chains.
guard.counter: revive from behind him; he turns only when a slam starts

squad._doc: T-232: the rules that read the squad. A hurt player (under hurt_fraction of max HP, within hurt_range m, in his sight) becomes his target ('Nobody gets left. Nobody.', every hurt_say_every s) and the dread layer reads him looking at you. A lone player (one alive): Haymaker and Zombie Throw cooldowns x alone_cd_mult (pressure), but Grab & Squeeze holds at most alone_grab_max s and breaks on alone_grab_mash melee presses (fair in solo).

rage._doc: Section 5.3. per_pct_damage: +1 per 1% of max HP; flee_per_s per fleeing player (sprinting away within flee_radius after he targeted them); flee_break (T-232) at once when a player he could see sprints out of his sight within flee_radius, at most every flee_break_every s per player; down_burst once per downed player he sees, then down_per_s each; cool_per_s after cool_after s without damage; bottle_cool per broken bottle (bottles x bottle_hp solo, scaled like his HP, regrown on a return); cup_dip from the tin-cup idle. Stages: angry_at / berserk_at with a hysteresis on the way down.

moves._doc: Section 5.4: stage = the lowest rage stage it unlocks at (0 Calm, 1 Angry, 2 BERSERK); telegraph seconds (pose + sound + light); damage; cooldown seconds; range / min_range metres.

grab.counter: teammates hit him for 6% or break a bottle; solo mash melee 8

thunderclap.counter: get out of the cone or behind cover

charge.counter: side-step; a wall stuns him 2 s

headframe_dive.counter: keep moving; the shadow follows 0.6 s then locks

arena._doc: Kaltenbrunn geometry (gen_map01.gd): the headframe's centre at the yard floor and its height to the head platform; yard_radius around it for the Headframe Climb & Dive; the lift shaft's top mouth (A side of Door_Lift) and its bottom (F's lift mouth); vault_box = the Core Vault (zone I) he never enters [min xyz, max xyz]; wait_point in G where he waits, roaring.

arrival._doc: Section 5.2: the headframe shakes (shake_s), the PA roar at pa_at, the Operator at opr_at, the leap from the head platform at leap_at, flight leap_s, the crater at land_point knocks down every player within knockdown_radius for knockdown_s (no damage), then the title card. radio_room: where the torn-off door lies (cosmetic).

archive._doc: Section 5.7 (Archive items; LORE section 13.3 reserves them). %PAUL_LASTNAME% / %PAUL_UNIT% resolve through likeness.json with its defaults (an empty default leaves nothing: 'Pvt. Paul').

ARC_HB_PAUL.title: PAUL
ARC_HB_PAUL.text: Pvt. Paul, a US Army combat engineer, captured in the Ardennes in the autumn of 1944. The strongest, loudest and most loyal man in his unit: the one who carried everyone's pack, the one who never let anybody fall out. Projekt Wiederkehr dosed him with Ironhide Stout to find the most a man could survive. He kept surviving, and he kept asking where his buddies were. At the end he knew us for his own. Inspired by Paul.

INT_HB_02.title: POW Card: Pvt. Paul
INT_HB_02.text:
An index card from Abteilung III's intake drawer, stained with stout, left on the floor of the torn-up radio room. Typed, with handwritten entries. Translated.

KRIEGSGEFANGENEN-KARTEIKARTE. Abt. III, Aufnahme Kaltenbrunn. (Prisoner-of-war index card. Abteilung III intake.)
Name: PAUL, %PAUL_LASTNAME%. Rank: Private. Arm of service: Engineers (USA). Unit: %PAUL_UNIT%.
Taken: Ardennes, autumn 1944. Condition on arrival: excellent. "Refuses to stop talking."
Assigned: tolerance series IRON (Helvetia preparation "Eisenhaut").
Dose, by session: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 12x, 20x. Each one initialled: survived.
Remarks: "Subject asks after the men of his unit at every session. Subject offers to take their doses. Request declined."
Last entry, in red: "30x. Subject did not stop. Continue."

On the back, in pencil, in big careful capitals, in English: "TELL THE GUYS I'M OK."

INT_HB_03.title: Letter to the Unit
INT_HB_03.text:
A letter on Red Cross form paper, never posted, folded into the band of a torn wool cap by the headframe. Pencil.

Dear fellas,
They let me write one. Don't know if it gets anywhere. If it does: I'm fine. Food's lousy, the doc's a sourpuss, and they keep giving me this beer that tastes like a tin roof. I keep drinking it so they don't give it to anybody else.
Somebody tell me who won the Series. I had two bucks riding on it, and I'm not paying if I lost, on account of being indisposed.
When this is over the first round is on me. Every round. You know I'm good for it.
Keep your heads down and your feet dry. Somebody carry Eddie's pack up the hills. He won't ask.
Your pal,
Paul
P.S. If you're reading this and you're not my guys, this is a letter. You're supposed to send it. That's how letters work.

lines._doc: Section 8 (8.1 the Operator, 8.3 PAUL, 8.5 the squad). Baked placeholder TTS in data/gravelight/vo/lines.json takes over when present; else the subtitle shows silently. speaker: PAU (the boss; shown as PAUL), OPR, or a squad code.

PAU_LAND_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAND_01.text: [a roar with a man's voice inside it]

PAU_CALM_02.speaker: PAU
PAU_CALM_02.text: Gimme your pack. I got it. I GOT it.

PAU_FLEE_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_FLEE_01.text: DON'T YOU RUN! Nobody runs out on the squad!

PAU_ANGRY_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_ANGRY_01.text: You're not my guys. YOU'RE NOT MY GUYS!

PAU_GRAB_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_GRAB_01.text: GOT you. Who sent you? WHERE ARE THEY?

PAU_LAST_DUT_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_DUT_01.text: ...Hey. Sarge. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_PEG_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_PEG_01.text: ...Hey. Ma'am. You're English? Huh. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_DEA_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_DEA_01.text: ...Hey. Grease on your hands. Good man. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_WRN_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_WRN_01.text: ...Hey. You're not one of them. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_BLT_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_BLT_01.text: ...Hey. Kid. Nice hammer. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_VEN_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_VEN_01.text: ...Hey. Mister. You look like a man who keeps his word. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_01.text: Oh my! A {gentleman} from overseas has broken into the {studio}! Do give him a warm welcome!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_02.text: Ladies and gentlemen, our {strongest} account! Tremendous {tolerance}. Simply tremendous!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_03.text: Back by popular {demand}! And bigger than {ever}!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_RAGE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_RAGE_01.text: Oh dear. He's gone right {off} the chart. We'll need a bigger {chart}!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_LEFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_LEFT_01.text: And he's off to find his {friends}! Aren't we {all}.

DUT_PAUL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_01.text: That's an American voice on the PA. ...That's an American VOICE.

DUT_PAUL_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_02.text: Big fella's wearing dog tags. Ours. Aw, hell.

DUT_PAUL_RAGE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_RAGE_01.text: The bottles on his back! Shoot the bottles, calm him down!

DUT_PAUL_DEAD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_DEAD_01.text: Every unit's got one. The big one. The one who carries you.

DUT_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_CUP_01.text: ...I'll buy the round, Paul. I'll buy every round.

PEG_PAUL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_01.text: American. A private, engineers, what's left of the sleeve says so. They did this to one of ours.

PEG_PAUL_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_02.text: The bottles on his back are feeding him. Break them and he cools.

PEG_PAUL_DEAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_DEAD_01.text: Note it. Private Paul. Carried his share. ...Somebody in London ought to read that.

PEG_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_CUP_01.text: I'll see it gets home, Private. You have my word.

DEA_PAUL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_01.text: That's a soldier. That's a GI. Lord have mercy, what'd they pump into him?

DEA_PAUL_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_02.text: Easy, big man. Easy. Nobody's leaving you.

DEA_PAUL_PRAYER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_PRAYER_01.text: Lord, this man carried his brothers when they couldn't carry themselves. Carry him now. He's done his share. Amen.

DEA_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_CUP_01.text: I'll keep it shined for you.

WRN_PAUL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_01.text: They dosed him to see when he would die. He would not die. ...I know this file. I know this kind of file.

WRN_PAUL_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_02.text: The back of his neck, when he turns. The line goes in there.

WRN_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_CUP_01.text: I will carry it. He carried enough.
